## Plugin Submission / Update

- **Plugin ID**: `yourname.my-plugin`
- **Repository**: https://github.com/...
- **Type**: [ ] New Plugin  [ ] Version Update

### Checklist
- [ ] Added/updated `plugins/<id>/plugin.json` only (did not manually edit `registry.json`)
- [ ] `name` and `description` are written in clear English
- [ ] `download_url` uses `https://` and points to a `.zip` archive with `manifest.json`
- [ ] `sha256` matches the 64-char SHA-256 checksum of the `.zip` archive
- [ ] Tested locally inside Raglex
